gloss: soda water; carbonated water; sparkling water

definitions.gloss: soda water; carbonated water; sparkling water
definitions.explanation: water infused with carbon dioxide gas, producing bubbles

examples.japanese: ウイスキーをソーダ{水|すい}で{割|わ}る。
examples.english: To mix whisky with soda water.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}い{日|ひ}にはソーダ{水|すい}が{気持|きも}ちいい。
examples.english: Soda water feels refreshing on a hot day.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{健康志向|けんこうしこう}でソーダ{水|すい}をそのまま{飲|の}む{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Recently, due to health consciousness, more people are drinking soda water straight.

notes:
Carbonated water, either plain or used as a mixer. Composed of ソーダ (soda, from English) + {水|すい} (water). In Japan, ソーダ{水|すい} specifically refers to plain carbonated water without added sweeteners, distinguishing it from flavored sodas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ソーダ{水|すい}で{割|わ}る — to dilute/mix with soda water
- ハイボール — highball (whisky + soda water, extremely popular in Japan)
- {焼酎|しょうちゅう}のソーダ{割|わ}り — shochu mixed with soda water
- レモンソーダ{水|すい} — lemon soda water

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {炭酸水|たんさんすい} — carbonated water (the more common everyday term)
- {炭酸|たんさん}{飲料|いんりょう} — carbonated beverage (broader category including cola, etc.)
- サイダー — cider (in Japan, means lemon-lime soda, not apple cider)
- ラムネ — ramune (traditional Japanese marble-sealed soda)
